11 skill tiles: Post Writer, Comment Drafter, Reply Handler, Profile Optimizer, Content Planner, Humanizer, Hook Extractor, Repurposer, Thread Monitor, Engagement Analytics, Employee Advocacy
Sample post: 'I lost $10K before I learned this lesson. Hard work isn't enough. Tracking the right numbers is. Here's what changed everything for me:'
Sample reply to 'Morgan James, Product Lead': 'Completely agree, Morgan -- speed without direction just gets you lost faster.'
Content Planner week: Mon Write post -- Hook #7; Tue Comment on 6 posts; Wed Reply to all DMs; Thu Draft article outline; Fri Post + engage 30 min; Sat Rest -- no action; Sun Plan next week

Humanizer panel: 'This isn't just a tactic -- it's a game changer. Moreover, it will elevate your entire strategy.' -> flags Em dashes / AI buzzwords / Claude watermark / AI detectors (5/5) -> Removed/Removed/Removed/Passed; 'Checking content: Detector 1-4' checklist

cta: Follow and comment 'X' to get the setup guide by DM

relevance.why: Founder marketing on LinkedIn is a real lever, and skill packs that encode hook formulas + a humanizer are directly reusable in Claude Code. But it is text generation only, not account automation, and the creator oversells it.

implement_score.why: Cheap to try: clone the repo, drop the skills folder into ~/.claude/skills or install the plugin, and use Post Writer + Humanizer for weekly LinkedIn drafts. Half a day. The Hook Extractor and Content Planner ideas are also worth stealing into our own content skill.
